acceptance: A launch with --exclude never assigns an excluded id to a lane (a test drives the wave plan with a fixture inbox)
A launch with --only assigns only listed ids
An --only id that no lane can take exits 10 at launch with GOAL_NAMES_INERT_ITEMS and its reason
An id in both --only and --exclude exits 10 at launch naming the id
No inbox file is changed by either flag
The detached child, the chain re-exec and the boundary loop step each carry the same selector (one test per path)
fix: Add the launch-scoped flags `evolve loop --only <id,...>` and `--exclude <id,...>`. Apply them to the inbox backlog at the one plan injection point, loopwave plan.go:37 (before triagecap.SelectWaveSeedMenus). Thread them through cfg.DetachArgv, the chain re-exec argv (relaunchArgv) and the boundary loop step.
routed_reason: operator 2026-10-27: lane-safe item; the evo loop builds the Todo work (curator reroute proposal, no protected surface, no pipeline kind)
summary: Option (c) of goal-text-has-no-selection-authority (PR #1060) only refuses a goal that names an item no lane can take, or WARNs. An operator still cannot tell the wave plan 'work these, not that'. The only lever is `evolve inbox route-console`, which changes the item for every later wave.
title: evolve loop has no selector that includes or excludes inbox items; goal text only warns
